core_meaning.short_meaning: Servant; commonly the first element of a compound name
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abdel represents Arabic عبد (ʿabd), meaning servant; in many North African name forms it functions as the first element of a compound, whose full meaning depends on the following element.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Arabic عبد (ʿabd) means servant and is often the first element of compound names such as Abdelaziz or Abdelhadi. The Latin form Abdel alone does not identify the second element, so “servant of God” should not be assumed without a complete compound such as عبد الله.

faq.a: Abdel represents Arabic عبد (ʿabd), meaning servant; the complete meaning depends on whether it forms part of a compound name.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdel?
faq.a: The recorded element عبد is Arabic and is often used as the first element in compound names.
Yes. The underlying element is Arabic عبد (ʿabd).

faq.q: What is the root of Abdel?
faq.a: The form is associated with the Arabic root ع ب د (ʿ-b-d), related to servitude and worship.
Abdel is used in Muslim naming contexts, but the element alone does not specify whom the servant serves.
This record does not establish Abdel as a Qur'anic personal name; Arabic origin alone is not proof of scriptural status.

faq.q: What does Abdel mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, عبد means بندہ or خادم. “اللہ کا بندہ” requires the full compound عبد الله.
The supplied “ab-del” is an approximate romanization of the name element عبد.

faq.q: Is Abdel a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: The record classifies Abdel as masculine in naming usage, but its use as a standalone form versus a compound element varies by community.
